R1.description: A timed set's duration is shown as m:ss everywhere a person reads it outside Progress

R2.description: The timed set's pad is an m:ss pad: digits fill from the right, Set stores whole seconds, the field says so, and a value over the range is clamped

R3.description: Every number pad opens on the current value, selected: first key replaces, Backspace clears, Cancel keeps, Set unchanged confirms, a rotation keeps it

R4.description: Nothing stored changes: a timed set and a rest are whole seconds, backup and CSV keep raw seconds, the plan range and the 5 s step are as before

R5.description: Rest is typed and shown as m:ss: the plan rest line and Settings' Other use the m:ss pad titled Rest, and the pending row, warm-up hints and plan row meta show the clock

R6.description: The pad looks as boards 50h and 10l draw it, apart from the declared differences, and the selected value is visibly selected in both themes
